title: Rotorua Museum

terrainReference.basis: Original public terrain in front of the central west entrance and outside the footprint.

mapIdentity.provider: OpenStreetMap named Rotorua Museum building footprint
mapIdentity.scope: Rotorua Museum in January 2016. The January photographs show the completed former Bath House with its central west entry, Tudor Revival timber detailing, paired north and south transepts, roofs, lanterns and Centennial wings.

note: The named 55-point outline fixes the completed north and south wings. The 2016 roof and facade photographs establish the long terracotta roof, revival timber patterns, central bay and lanterns. Retain the independent Government Gardens elevation field.
